sections.title: Overview
sections.content:
"Think nothing of it. Thank the great spirits I was able to find you.
Lord Tridon sent me in search of our last brethren, in preparation for our final assault against that heretic.
We lost contact with you when Lord Zedus valiantly gave himself to protect the evacuation of Athensphere.
O great spirits...our Lord has survived this ordeal!
You did what you could, Andaria. Lord Zedus surely gives his thanks."
— Deimos in Void Mirage

Deimos is a Non-Player Character (NPC) in the game. He is one of the demigods of Athensphere. In the Echo of Athensphere timeline, he is known as The Armorer.

sections.title: In-Game Appearance
sections.content: As an NPC character, Deimos first appears in Raid:X2.
